aluminium.title: Aluminium Work
aluminium.intro: Aluminium is light, durable and low-maintenance — ideal for windows, doors and shopfronts. Everything is cut, assembled and glazed to your measurements in our workshop, then fitted on site.

sections.title: Windows & doors
sections.text: Casement and sliding windows, single and double doors, with the glass and locking hardware suited to the opening.

sections.title: Sliding systems
sections.text: Smooth sliding windows and doors for balconies, lounges and commercial fronts, balanced for daily use.

sections.title: Partitions
sections.text: Aluminium-framed internal partitions to divide offices, shops or rooms without losing light.

sections.title: Shopfronts
sections.text: Aluminium shopfront framing built around your branding, shutter and access requirements.

aluminium.cta: Get a free measure & quote for aluminium work

glass.title: Glass Work
glass.intro: From a single shower cabin to a full 12mm shopfront — we supply, cut to size and fit glass properly, with the right thickness and finish for the job.

sections.title: Shower cabins
sections.text: Framed and frameless shower enclosures measured to your bathroom, sealed and finished on site.

sections.title: Glass doors & partitions
sections.text: Clear, frosted or tinted glass doors and partitions for offices, shops and homes.

sections.title: Railings
sections.text: Glass balustrades and railings for stairs and balconies, fitted with the correct clamps and channels.

sections.title: 12mm shopfronts
sections.text: Heavy-duty 12mm shopfront glazing for commercial fronts, set into aluminium framing.

glass.cta: Get a free measure & quote for glass work

wood-interior.title: Wood Interior
wood-interior.intro: Kitchens, wardrobes, ceilings and panelling — designed around your space, built in our workshop, and installed by our own team.

sections.title: Kitchen cabinets
sections.text: Base and wall cabinets with the layout, storage and finish you choose, built to your kitchen's exact dimensions.

sections.title: Wardrobes
sections.text: Fitted wardrobes that use the full height of the room, with the internal layout you actually need.

sections.title: False ceiling
sections.text: Wood and mixed-material false ceilings with clean edges and provision for lighting.

sections.title: Wood panelling
sections.text: Feature walls and full-room panelling in the finish that matches your interior.
